text:
The atmosphere is tense as Shae Vizla's crew, closed up together in a safehouse, prepare for their next attack against Heta Kol and the Hidden Chain. Nerva, one of Vizla's mercenaries, is annoyed with the slicer Besrik and is about to punch him when Vizla intervenes, ordering Nerva to stand down and Besrik to get back to work. Darth Malgus, watching the confrontation from the corridor, fills Nerva with unease. In the next room, Vizla gives Besrik orders for his upcoming mission.

Some time later, Vizla and her crew have come to an old warehouse to meet Besrik's broker. He has bad news: the slicer has disappeared, his mission an evident failure. This means they will not be able to sneak through Sith space to reach Khar Shian, Heta Kol's new base. Malgus and Vizla argue about their next move. Vizla wants to fly through the Stygian Caldera nebula, but Nalgus believes that this will bring certain destruction. He tells Vizla that she should either stop trying to avoid bloodshed, or else abandon her obsessive pursuit of Heta Kol. Nerva, though far across the warehouse, hears every word perfectly. She crosses to them to ask what comes next. This breaks up the argument. Vizla declares that they will go to Khar Shian, one way or the other, and turns to leave, trailed by the other crewmates, Barlit and Maelee.

Nerva lingers behind with Malgus. He begins to ask questions while probing her mind. Nerva tries to resist but cannot hide her Force-sensitivity from the Sith Lord. He demands to know why she squanders her talents fighting for the Mandalorians. Nerva says that she has seen what happens to Sith and wants no part of it. She rejects the Sith concepts of power and freedom, preferring to simply go on living. Besides, she says, the money is good, and Vizla is a good boss. Malgus tells her that she must seek her own path to power, even if it is a path that the Sith do not know about, and stomps away. 

Back in the safehouse, Nerva finds Vizla distractedly toying with a comm unit. As they talk, the Mandalorian reveals Darth Malgus's preferred plan for reaching Khar Shian: he wants Vizla to rally her loyal Mandalorian warriors for a direct assault. This would involve losses unacceptable to Vizla. Unlike the Sith Empire, she refuses to use her own people as cannon fodder. Vizla does not think that her Trat'ade could win a direct fight against Hidden Chain, but she believes that she and her small crew can finish things, and she trusts Malgus to protect them in the nebula. They will leave the next day.

Soon after, Vizla and her crew hurtle through the Stygian Caldera aboard the Whisper. The dust and bolts of energy are wreaking havoc on the shuttle's navigation systems. Vizla turns to Malgus for help, but he stubbornly refuses to use his Force powers to protect them. He growls, [quoted words omitted]–apparently to Vizla, but Nerva understands that he is directing the words at her. The ship's controls go dark and the engines lose power. Vizla rises from her seat to confront Malgus. Nerva takes her place, the energy storm outside shaking the shuttle. As the maelstrom crescendoes, Nerva reaches out her hand and creates a Force barrier around the spacecraft. Everything is suddenly quiet. 

The Whisper continues drifting and finally reaches the far side of the nebula. Nerva collapses in exhaustion. Her crewmates stare in shock, while Malgus's old face shows only approval. Two Hidden Chain shuttles now come into view. The crew prepare for hand-to-hand combat: their ship may be dead in space, but they have a chance to seize the Hidden Chain ships and use them to finish the journey, one final path to Khar Shian.
title: Last Road to Khar Shian
